Each chart page compares its unsplit EPS-to-TXT page with a glyph overview, then shows each glyph once with its source marked by color. Org is the original chart font; Alt keeps its glyphs and may supplement missing ones with exact matches from the same manuscript. Both TrueType downloads are on the chart page.

::: {.font-source-note}
TXT matrices are plain 0/1 stitch grids and are the reusable motif files. TTF paths are verified against those grids. The TTF is vector geometry: its cell pattern is exact, while a word processor may rasterize or antialias it differently at different sizes. No EPS files are included.
Download links are kept on each individual font page.
:::
